==========================================
PHASE 2 REMAINING (HIGH SEVERITY)
==========================================

**2.4 — Add fetch timeout to widget**
File: `extensions/zip-code-widget/blocks/zip-code-checker.liquid`
Every `fetch(...)` call in this widget has no timeout. Add a helper at top of the script:
```js
function zccFetch(url, opts) {
  var ctrl = new AbortController();
  var t = setTimeout(function() { ctrl.abort(); }, 5000);
  var o = Object.assign({}, opts || {}, { signal: ctrl.signal });
  return fetch(url, o).finally(function() { clearTimeout(t); });
}
```
Replace every `fetch(API_BASE + ...)` call with `zccFetch(...)`. Preserve exact behavior otherwise.

**2.7 — Page-overflow guards in waitlist + feature-requests**
Files: `app/routes/app.waitlist.tsx`, `app/routes/app.feature-requests.tsx`
Add `useEffect(() => { if (currentPage > totalPages && totalPages > 0) setCurrentPage(1); }, [totalPages, currentPage])` after the existing state declarations that compute totalPages.

**2.8 — Loading states on Polaris primary actions / modal primary actions**
Files: `app/routes/app.delivery-rules.tsx`, `app/routes/app.waitlist.tsx`, `app/routes/app.feature-requests.tsx`, `app/routes/app.widget-visibility.tsx`, `app/routes/app.zip-codes.tsx`
For every Polaris `<Modal primaryAction={...}>` or Page `primaryAction={...}` that fires a fetcher, pass `loading: fetcher.state !== "idle"` and `disabled: fetcher.state !== "idle"`. Don't introduce new state — just forward the fetcher's state.

**2.12 — Pricing cancel modal bypass via overlay click**
File: `app/routes/app.pricing.tsx`
Find the `cancelModalOpen` Modal. Ensure it has both a destructive primary action AND a clearly labeled non-destructive secondary action ("Keep my plan"). If the secondary is missing or weak, fix it. If already fine, skip.

**2.13 — Waitlist destructive action confirm parity**
File: `app/routes/app.waitlist.tsx`
If "Clear notified" and bulk-delete don't already go through a confirmation Modal like the single-delete does, wrap them using the existing confirm-modal pattern. Do not invent new state mechanisms.

**2.14 — Delivery rule validation on client**
File: `app/routes/app.delivery-rules.tsx`
Action-side validation is DONE. Add client-side: TextFields `minOrderAmount`, `deliveryFee`, `freeShippingAbove` should show `error` when negative/NaN (validate live). Submit handler must reject early if `selectedDays.length === 0`, showing a Polaris `InlineError` or Banner under the day checkboxes.

**2.15 — Shop-in-where for delete/read timing leak in waitlist + feature-requests**
Files: `app/routes/app.waitlist.tsx`, `app/routes/app.feature-requests.tsx`
Replace `findUnique({ where: { id } })` + `.shop !== shop` check with `findFirst({ where: { id, shop } })`. For `delete`, use `deleteMany({ where: { id, shop } })` and check `count` return (`if (result.count === 0) return { error: "Not found" }`). Same for `updateMany`.

==========================================
PHASE 3 (MEDIUM)
==========================================

**3.1** — `app/routes/app.analytics.tsx`: remove unused `useIndexResourceState` call since `selectable={false}`. Delete the dead destructuring.

**3.2** — `app/plans.ts`: add `console.warn("[plans] Unknown plan name:", planName)` before the "free" fallback in `getPlanTier`.

**3.3** — `app/billing.server.ts`: in `syncSubscriptionFromShopify`, extract trial end. If Shopify response has a trial period, compute `trialEndsAt = createdAt + trialDays` and persist to `Subscription.trialEndsAt`. Only set when non-null; never overwrite non-null with null.

**3.4** — `app/routes/webhooks.app_subscriptions.update.tsx`: add a shape check before processing:
```ts
interface AppSubscriptionPayload {
  app_subscription?: { name?: string; status?: string; admin_graphql_api_id?: string };
}
const sub = (payload as AppSubscriptionPayload)?.app_subscription;
if (!sub || typeof sub.name !== "string" || typeof sub.status !== "string") {
  console.error("[webhook:app_subscriptions] malformed payload", payload);
  return new Response();
}
```
Remove any `as any` cast on the payload.

**3.6** — `app/routes/app.delivery-rules.tsx`: when loader's product/collection name lookup fails, return `namesError: true` alongside the names. In the component, render a Polaris `Banner tone="warning"` above the list when `namesError` is true: "Couldn't load product/collection names — showing IDs. Refresh to retry."

**3.7** — `app/routes/app._index.tsx`: dashboard CTAs. Use `useNavigation()` from react-router — when `navigation.state !== "idle"`, show `loading` on the Button whose target matches `navigation.location?.pathname`.

```ts
const prevState = useRef(fetcher.state);
useEffect(() => {
  if (prevState.current === "submitting" && fetcher.state === "idle" && fetcher.data && "success" in fetcher.data) {
```

==========================================


Apply ONLY to unhandled-error console.error lines, not to debug/success logs.

**4.7** — `app/routes/app.onboarding.tsx`: when invalid step param defaults to 1, add `console.warn("[onboarding] Invalid step param:", stepParam)`.

PROCESS
==========================================

1. Work one file at a time. Read only what you need.
2. After each file's edits, run typecheck. If it breaks, FIX before moving on.
